extraction: rows where the stripped line starts with '| MC-'; 4 cells per row; header excluded

cases.scenario: Complete scoped pilot; passing executions, authorized attestations, exact execution-scope matches
cases.outcome: `COMPLETE` / `PASS` for the declared pilot only

cases.scenario: One subject has no required evidence in an otherwise complete graph
cases.outcome: `COMPLETE` / `FAIL`; identify the subject and missing relationship

cases.scenario: One case has several records; another case has none
cases.outcome: Fail the uncovered case; no global-count pass

cases.scenario: Several graph paths reach the same evidence target
cases.outcome: Count one distinct target per subject

cases.scenario: Valid scope resolves to no subjects despite non-empty policy
cases.outcome: `COMPLETE` / `FAIL` with population diagnostic

cases.scenario: Missing membership, broken selector, ambiguous ID, or wrong target type
cases.outcome: Error/indeterminate as specified; never an empty-population pass

cases.scenario: Explicit, supported non-applicability
cases.outcome: `NOT_APPLICABLE` with reason, not completed engineering work

cases.scenario: Unknown applicability, missing API page/reference, or truncated traversal
cases.outcome: `INDETERMINATE`; no pass

cases.scenario: Unsupported predicate, invalid cardinality, or unknown status literal
cases.outcome: Contract `ERROR` before normative evaluation

cases.scenario: Ordinary selector includes a method contract
cases.outcome: Scope validation error; shared type references alone remain legal

cases.scenario: Different Git/API/ontology/method/evaluator/policy identity
cases.outcome: Refuse the mismatched evaluation

cases.scenario: API enumeration order and timestamps differ, semantic inputs identical
cases.outcome: Same canonical conformance payload

cases.scenario: Configuration, evaluation scope, or meaningful ordered collection changes
cases.outcome: Different evaluation identity; recompute rather than reuse

cases.scenario: Reimport changes API UUIDs while explicit IDs and meaning remain stable
cases.outcome: Preserve identity correspondence without name-based merging

cases.scenario: Accepted evidence records a failed execution
cases.outcome: Fail an obligation requiring a passing execution

cases.scenario: Record says accepted but lacks attributable authorized decision
cases.outcome: No acceptance pass; missing authority is explicit

cases.scenario: Verification-case text unchanged, implementation/configuration/test/inputs change
cases.outcome: No automatic evidence carry-forward; scope mismatch fails

cases.scenario: Execution scope cannot establish required dependency boundary
cases.outcome: Indeterminate validity, not inferred freshness

cases.scenario: Evidence is committed after execution
cases.outcome: Compare tested-scope identity; no impossible self-containing Git SHA requirement

cases.scenario: Conflicting acceptance/rejection decisions lack valid supersession
cases.outcome: Unresolved acceptance; no timestamp-based winner

cases.scenario: Snapshot corrupt, incomplete, wrong-bound, or self-attested without trusted provenance
cases.outcome: Reject snapshot; never silently load latest

cases.scenario: Same verified inputs loaded through API and snapshot
cases.outcome: Identical canonical conformance payload

cases.scenario: Product candidate weakens obligation, interpretation, evaluator, or policy
cases.outcome: Governing-policy mismatch/migration blocker; no self-acceptance

cases.scenario: PR head/base moves while status is gathered
cases.outcome: `readiness = BLOCKED` for the exact PR-merge target, with `STALE_INPUT` and a head-moved/base-moved reason; no successful delivery verdict

cases.scenario: Required delivery obligation unsupported; model pilot passes
cases.outcome: Model pass stays scoped; full readiness does not pass

cases.scenario: Hindsight claims evidence exists but graph does not
cases.outcome: Memory does not change the result

cases.scenario: Blocking prerequisite cycle versus legitimate feedback loop
cases.outcome: Reject unsupported blocking cycle; allow separate feedback relation

cases.scenario: Remote artifact later unavailable; pinned record unchanged
cases.outcome: Historical model verdict reproducible; availability reported separately

cases.scenario: All selected obligations explicitly not applicable versus no executable phase contract
cases.outcome: First case: ASSESSED / COMPLETE / NOT_APPLICABLE; second: UNASSESSED / null / null; neither claims completed engineering work

cases.scenario: Evaluator API/snapshot comparison and independent manual pilot review disagree
cases.outcome: Block readiness and investigate; neither timeout nor partial result counts as acceptance

cases.scenario: Unmerged candidate revision is validated/imported with complete scope
cases.outcome: Conformance may be evaluated against that exact candidate revision; merge is not required

cases.scenario: Same verified candidate evaluated through API and validated local/CI snapshot
cases.outcome: Same canonical conformance payload

cases.scenario: A non-Phase-10 contract uses the same generic operators
cases.outcome: Evaluate without phase-specific code path; phase number does not alter semantics

cases.scenario: Phase has no reviewed executable contract yet
cases.outcome: UNASSESSED / null / null with CONTRACT_UNAVAILABLE reason; required broader exit readiness remains BLOCKED

cases.scenario: Approved phase contract exists; candidate is absent, invalid, or missing scope
cases.outcome: phase_contract returns method identity, obligations, and unresolved applicability inputs without a conformance verdict; no obligations silently disappear

cases.scenario: Caller has uncommitted edits or requests dirty-working-tree evaluation
cases.outcome: Export of a selected commit excludes uncommitted content and declares its commit identity; an explicit dirty-tree evaluation request is refused

cases.scenario: Candidate is imported and validated before merge, including concurrent candidates
cases.outcome: Candidate bindings remain isolated; published accepted-baseline selection is unchanged; validation does not imply approval

cases.scenario: Result fields include illegal combinations or missing required reasons/target
cases.outcome: Reject serialization; no verdict for INDETERMINATE/ERROR/UNASSESSED, null evaluation fields only as specified, and readiness always names its target

cases.scenario: Candidate fails a required exit condition while a corrective task has satisfied entry prerequisites
cases.outcome: Phase-exit readiness BLOCKED and corrective-task entry readiness READY may coexist under distinct explicit targets

cases.scenario: Broader scope mixes attempted and unassessed required units, including known child failures
cases.outcome: Preserve all child results and coverage lists/counts; aggregate coverage UNASSESSED with null evaluation/verdict, and broader exit readiness BLOCKED
